legend-corsica-bavella-route.slogan: Corsica Bavella Route – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-corsica-bavella-route.story: curated scenic road. granite peaks, forest, hairpins. A one-way ride of 43 km, Sari-Solenzara to Porto-Vecchio - roughly 47 min in the saddle. The highest point is about 1,200 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Corsica Bavella Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 16 km this is Corsica Bavella Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
